name: android_wait_for_condition
description: Polls host-side conditions (element_present, element_gone, activity_resumed, logcat_match) with configurable intervals and timeouts, saving multi-turn LLM polling overhead.

condition.description: Target state condition to wait for.

target.description: Target substring/regex for activity_resumed or logcat_match.

text.description: Target text to match for element_present/gone.

deviceSerial.description: Device serial or IP:port from android_list_devices. Required when several devices are connected; may be omitted when only one is.
